gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-nunito: Nunito rounds off every stroke, with big soft lowercase bowls and terminals that stop well short of the stem. Nunito sits friendly beside Outrun Future, whose wide-set, constant-width outlines carry a synthwave swagger of their own.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-pilcrow-roun: Outrun Future spaces its letters far apart and traces them in a single constant-width line, all synthwave authority. Pilcrow Rounded does the opposite job, packing tight, warm text with tall lowercase and curves that never quite close.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads like blown glass, with tall round bowls and bars of identical thickness. Outrun Future is the louder one, a wide-set synthwave voice with short ascenders, while Quicksand is the one that settles down and lets the words run.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-chillax: Chillax reads loose and unhurried, its lines trailing off like spaghetti with loops left unfinished. And Over There, drawn as if by a fixed-width nib, gets so much white space around each glyph that making it small would drain its vintage-military command.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-plein: Plein is reliable and clean, with a clear channel into each round letter. Give Plein the size adjustments rather than the heading, since Over There already carries its commanding, nib-drawn vintage-military look with curves that hold their thickness at the shoulders.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads contemporary and approachable, with generous gaps where curves meet stems and strokes of identical weight. And Over There is the one with vintage-military command, its nib-drawn letters spread wide, while Spline Sans handles the quiet, steady work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-over-there-plus-jakarta-sans: Drill-sergeant lettering meets a modern, precise hand, with Over There looking nib-drawn and widely spaced above Plus Jakarta Sans. Command above, precision below.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-hind: Hind reads steady and businesslike, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and its c never curling inward. Hind carries the text while Quantum, loose and open with compressed ascenders, gives the pair its clean tech feel.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-nunito: Nunito brings big round lowercase bowls and terminals that finish clear of the stem. Nunito softens Quantum, whose strokes have zero thick and thin contrast and whose letterfit is loose and clean.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Quantum looks clean and techy, with loose letterfit, open mouths and compressed ascenders sitting above Pilcrow Rounded's tall, warm lowercase. Loose against tight, and that's the point.
